headline: A 2013 law officially names the new Interstate 70 Mississippi River bridge between St. Louis and southwestern Illinois the Stan Musial Veterans Memorial Bridge.
what_it_does: This law gives a new name to the Interstate Route 70 bridge that crosses the Mississippi River between St. Louis, Missouri, and southwestern Illinois. The bridge is named after Stan Musial, a well-known St. Louis baseball player, and it also honors veterans. The law does not change how the bridge is built, paid for, tolled, or maintained.
when_it_takes_effect: The designation took effect when the law was enacted on July 12, 2013.
